buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up

to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Generic Bidders are advised to check applicable GST on their own before quoting. Buyer will not take any responsibility in this regards. GST reimbursement will be as per actuals or as per applicable rates (whichever is lower), subject to the maximum of quoted GST %. 3. Sample Clause After award of contract – Successful Bidder shall have to get advance sample approved from buyer before bulk manufacturing / starting bulk supplies. Successful Bidder shall submit 1 samples for Buyer's approval, within 7 days of award of contract. Buyer shall, as per contract specifications framework, either approve the advance sample or will provide complete list of modification required in the sample within 10 days of receipt of advance sample. Seller shall be required to ensure supply as per approved sample with modifications as communicated by Buyer. If there is delay from buyer side in approval of advance sample – the delivery period shall be refixed without LD for the period of delay in sample approval. In case, the sample is found to have major deviations / not conforming to the Contract specifications, the buyer at its discretion may call for fresh samples for approval before allowing bulk supplies or may terminate the contract after notifying the deviations to the seller. Unless otherwise provided in the contract, all samples required for test shall be supplied by the contractor free of cost. Where under the contract, the contractor is required to submit an advance sample, any expenses incurred by the contractor on or in connection with the production of stores in bulk, before the sample has been approved unconditionally shall be borne by the Seller and he shall not claim any compensation in the event of such sample being found unacceptable by the Buyer / Consignee. 4. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Title: Supply of Tower Spares for 400KV D/C Baglihar-Kishanpur Transmission line. 1. Scope of work: Supply of Tower spare as per BOQ at BHEP Chanderkote District Ramban, J&K including loading, P&F and F&I on FOR Destination basis. 2. Completion Period: Time for completion is the essence of the contract. The entire scope of supply shall be completed within 21 days from the date of issuance of letter of award/Purchase order for the work. 3. Warrantee/Defect Liability Period: the warranty period shall be 12 months from the date of supply and acceptance of consignee. 4. Estimated Amount: The estimated amount for the complete job is Rs 14.82 lacs including all taxes and d

uties. 5. Eligibility: The bidder shall have to upload documentary proof of similar nature of executed suppliers. 6. The bidders shall have to upload ITR of last 3 years. 7. The bidders shall upload GST registration certificate of firm. 8. The bidders shall upload scanned copy of PAN card of the firm. 9. The bidder shall have to upload average turnover certificate of last 3 years duly certified by CA. 10. E-PBG: The L1 bidder shall have to submit the e-PBG of 3 % of estimated value within 7 days after receipt of LOA with the validity of 6 months. 11. The quoted rates shall be inclusive of all GST @18%, Transit Insurance, Frieght charges and P&F etc. 12. EMD: Bidder shall have to upload of EMD@ 2% of the estimated cost in the form of CDR/FDR/BG pledged t o Chief Pay and Pay Accounts Officer BHEP Chanderkote. 13. MSME Exemption: MSME firms are allowed to participate with the exemptions over Tender cost, EMD, ex perience, financial turnover. 14. Payment terms: 90% payment alongwith 100 % taxes and duties will be made after successful completio n of supply and satisfaction of Engineer-in-charge and 10 % will be released after completion of DLP of 6 m onths. 15. Penalty/LD: If the contractor failed to complete the assign supply within completion time, the contractor s hall pay delay damages to owner for this default, the delay damage shall be at the rate of 0.5% per week subjected to maximum of 5% of the contract. This damaged delay shall not relieve the contractor from obli gations to complete the assignment or from other responsibilities, which may be having under the contrac t. Payment of above liquidated damages shall be owner’s sole and exclusive remedy. 16. Force majeure: The contractor will not come in default with any of his obligations under the contract and Employer shall e xtend the respective deadlines for performance of such obligations accordingly if by reason of an event be yond contractor’s control the contractor is impeded to perform such obligation (“Force Majeure”). Force M ajeure includes interferences to the execution of the contract, whether foreseeable or not, such as but not l imited to: - War (declared or undeclared), military mobilization, invasion, requisition or embargo, revoluti ons or riots and other hostilities. - Rebellion, revolution, insurrection, military or usurped power and civil war. - Ionizing radiation or contamination by radio activity from any nuclear fuel or from any nuclea r waste from the combustion of nuclear fuel, radio active toxic explosives, or other hazardous

properties of any explosive nuclear assembly or nuclear components thereof, natural calamitie s. - Epidemic diseases act of sabotage or terrorism. - During site installation: travel warning of the ministry of Foreign Affairs or the respective emb assy or consulate of the Contractor’s country for the country or the part of the country where t he site is located. - Breakdown or major repair of major factory equipment directly used and critical to the manuf acture of the equipment. - Accidents occurring in connection with transportation. - Changes in any law, acts decrees, orders or regulation of any governmental authority. - Acts of God, embargos, business restrictions by applicable export control regulations or acts of such authorities. The contractor shall notify the Employer in writing within 28 days following the occurrence of a Fo rce Majeure event, of the causes of delay and within a reasonable subsequent period giving detail ed information concerning the event, the effect thereof and his estimate of the extension of time necessitated by such event and the respective extra costs, which the Employer shall reimburse t o the contractor upon request. 17. Incase dipute arises and are not resoled mutually, the matter shall be referred for arbitration to the Chief E ngineer (E) BHEP whose decision shall be final and binding on both the parties. “The arbitral tribunal shall not have any right/jurisdiction to award any interest on claim which is determined by it in the arbitration p roceedings conducted by the tribunal.” . 5.
